title: Hello Multicloud
description: Day one of TenkaCloud's multicloud era. The previous SRE left a single line in the handover notes: 'the hello service must answer from BOTH clouds'. One deploy fans out two targets under a single problem — a Lambda Function URL on AWS and a Cloud Run service on Google Cloud — and the problem scores only when both hello endpoints answer 200. This is the hello-world of Composite Runtime: use it to confirm deploy, per-target status, namespaced outputs, scoring, and teardown work across clouds.
